question: Why does the speaker ask the beloved to listen now?
premises: The speaker intends to tell something accordingly.
Affection is given as the reason for speaking.
The beloved is urged to listen.
inference: Out of affection, the speaker continues the teaching and asks the beloved to pay attention.
uncertainties: The verbal root and precise sense of ādāmi are uncertain in this form.
plain_english: So I tell you out of affection; listen, O you who are dear to me as life.
